verdict.rationale: Gumloop's trigger docs describe app triggers that fire when something happens in an external service, plus webhook triggers that any app can POST to. Agents can also be invoked by Slack or Teams messages and by email sent to a dedicated address, which covers the message and email events in the story. missing for 10: an enumerated list of supported app trigger events (e.g., new CRM record, form submission), per-app trigger configuration detail, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an ops user, I can trigger workflows from events in connected apps (new record, message, email, form submission)
